utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — that really helps. I’ll let folks know we’ve got tape and screws covered and ask around for any small tools we might still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to hear — I only heard bits from the neighbors, so I’m glad the tape and screws are covered. I’ll keep an ear out in case anyone mentions other small tools they still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate it. I’ll keep checking with folks and let you know if we still need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli. I’ll try to make it to the repair drive on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll aim for the afternoon if I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal—that’d be a big help. If you spot any needed items on the bulletin board, just let me know and I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’ll check the bulletin board and let you know anything missing. I’ve still got it marked for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal. I’ll keep Sunday at the community center in mind and watch for anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center works better now. Patch mix and coordination would be great, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring the patch mix and filler, and I can help coordinate the drop-offs too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, Mara. I’ll send out the Sunday time and community center details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still keeping track of what we’re short on for the repair drive. If you hear of any extra donations coming in, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m still planning to swing by for a bit, and I’ll keep an ear out for any extra donations coming in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep tracking the shortages, and if anything else comes up, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane — we could still use the tape and any spare nails you can bring. Just come by when you’re ready, and we’ll get the repair drive patched up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring tape and whatever nails I can find, and I’ll head over soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, it’s on today, and folks are really pitching in to fix up the old community spots. I can point you to what needs doing if you want to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, just point me to the biggest need and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great—there’s a lot to do, but the old community hall needs the most help right now. I’ll point you there first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is starting soon. If you want, I can help spread the word a little.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I thought it was still Saturday at the front porch, but Sunday at the community center sounds right. I can pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — that should help a lot. I can mention the Sunday community center time to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations than expected.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s good, but did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Hana — quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. Let me know if you want the list of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for the update, Rosa. Yes, please send the list of what still needs doing so I can check the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send you the current list of tasks for Sunday at the community center right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll check the bulletin board—what time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m pretty sure it starts at 10, but I can double-check. And if you need anything, I can bring a few tools along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus—10 sounds good, and I’d appreciate you double-checking. If you’re bringing tools, I can make sure I work it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. Just please make sure everyone knows it’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell everyone it’s Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. Could you also remind people about the drop-off times and which items we’re accepting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, the repair drive—what time are you thinking? And can you confirm it’s actually happening at the community hall?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve heard it’s happening today at the community hall, but I’d still check with the organizers for the exact time. I’ll keep spreading the word either way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it is at the community hall today, but the exact time still needs confirming? I just want to make sure I’ve got that right.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by and see what’s still needed, then I’ll let folks know. If you’ve got a time in mind, I can help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira—I'll check the bulletin board, but if you hear a start time, let me know. I need to work it around the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and pass it along if I hear a start time. I’ll make sure it’s something that works around pickup if I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still checking what’s needed, but it sounds like the drive is in pretty good shape. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good — just let me know the drop-off details when you have them. I might mix up the day, so remind me it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll remind you it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll pass along the drop-off details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I heard it’s picking up a few more donations than expected. I’m a bit forgetful, but I can help keep an eye out for anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. I can swing by and check what’s still needed for the repair drive, and if you spot any tools or supplies, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll keep my eyes open for any tools or supplies around the neighborhood. Just let me know what’s still needed when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — Sunday at the community center works, I just wanted to confirm the exact drop-off spot and timing first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the exact drop-off time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — just send the time when you have it, and I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can bring the patch mix and filler, and I can help coordinate drop-offs too if that would help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That would be a huge help, Mara—thank you. I can handle the sign-in and set up a spot for the drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll bring the patch mix and filler, and I can help keep the drop-offs organized too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits from the neighbors, so I’m not totally sure yet. Do you know what they still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I haven’t checked the list yet, but I can swing by and see what’s still needed. Just let me know what tools you’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the community center on Sunday now; I’ll note that and check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Let me know what’s still needed when you check it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll swing by the community center and check the spots that still need fixing, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are pitching in to fix up the old community spots—pretty nice to see everyone helping out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time are you thinking for the repair drive? And where should folks drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’d aim for late afternoon, maybe by the community center—easy for folks to swing by and drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Late works for me, and keeping it quiet is best.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll come by late and keep it quiet. Just point me to the easiest task for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll show you the easiest one when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on a few basics, so I’m keeping a close eye on supplies. If you hear anyone with spare tools or tape, send them our way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that—I'll keep an ear out for spare tools or tape and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I really appreciate it. If you hear about any gloves, screws, or a flashlight too, let me know.
